name: Sack of Supplies
summary: Across Razorwind Canyon, the sacks of supplies bound for Rezlak lie scattered among harpy roosts. Dustwind harpies seized the goods as they crossed Durotar.

sections.title: A Plundered Caravan
sections.body: Rezlak needs a steady supply of goods for his work outside Orgrimmar. Gazlowe contracted the goblin engineer from Ratchet to build for the Horde. A caravan carrying a promised shipment passed near the canyon road south of Orgrimmar. Dustwind harpies ambushed it and dragged the cargo into their roosts in Razorwind Canyon, scattering sacks beside their nests in the dirt and scree.

faq.q: What is inside these supply sacks?
faq.answer: The sacks hold construction materials and trade goods for Gazlowe's engineering work. They are meant to support Orcish building projects near Orgrimmar. Without them, Rezlak cannot finish his work.
Dustwind harpies stole the supplies. This savage avian race infests the high crevices and ravines of Razorwind Canyon.
Rezlak is a goblin engineer Gazlowe sent from Ratchet to help the Horde build and maintain line infrastructure in Durotar.

angles.text: Recovering the supplies from local predators keeps frontier construction around Orgrimmar moving without costly delays.
